description: Phase 5b.3 — calibration matrix defining matchup pairs + expected MPA win-rate bands. The calibration suite (tools/run_mpa_calibration.py) runs each matchup via /playtest/benchmark_v1, compares actual to expected, and flags drift. role_tag references resolve via opposition_decks_v1 registry.

matchups.description: Strong cEDH combo deck vs Wizards precon — should be a near-blowout for B5.
matchups.rationale: Largest power gap in the matrix. If B5 doesn't crush B2, either MPA can't pilot the combo (policy limitation) or B2 precons are stronger than the bracket assumes.

matchups.description: Optimized tribal-goodstuff vs Wizards precon — large but not maximal gap.
matchups.rationale: B4 should win decisively but Atraxa-precon is one of the strongest precons (5-color, +1/+1 counters synergy).

matchups.description: Optimized graveyard-combo vs upgraded vampire-tribal — adjacent brackets.
matchups.rationale: B4 advantage should be real but small. Muldrotha is heavy on engine-build turns; if MPA can't pilot the graveyard engine the advantage collapses.

matchups.description: Upgraded aristocrats-combo vs Wizards precon — adjacent brackets.
matchups.rationale: B3 upgrade-tier should beat B2 precon but not crush. Necrobloom's combo lines may require >25 turns; if so, expect more draws.

matchups.description: cEDH tempo vs optimized stax — adjacent top brackets.
matchups.rationale: Yuriko tempo should outpace Sauron stax, but stax can stall games long enough to favor draws on the MPA's heuristic policy.

matchups.description: Anti-bias check — same deck on both sides. Win rate must be ~50%; drift indicates first-player seat bias.
matchups.rationale: Pillow-fort variant chosen because it's defensive and unlikely to race; mirror match isolates seat bias from deck asymmetry. Tight band — anti-bias rule 1.4 violation if outside.
